name: Needle Bounce
notes: Tympo kick hits kick a real spring (3.2 Hz, zeta 0.25): at rest A = 100%; a full-strength hit throws the needle to ~110%, it swings back below rest (~98%) and settles (a sustained step would overshoot by e^(-zeta*pi/sqrt(1-zeta^2)) = 44%). The spring is a bounded FIR approximation of a stateful spring (its impulse response over the ~3% envelope, unit DC gain), exact up to that window. With the spring on, outputs extrapolate past their range (A dips below 100%, B past +/-3 deg): the ranges are the settled scale, the bounce rides on top. The spring needs input history: the host evaluates a window ending at the current frame. A Linked (Input A scalar) source cannot drive it.
